## Chat export fixes

- The toolbar popup can reconnect on `teams.cloud.microsoft` when the page’s content script missed startup.
- Direct export tries the chat history service on the cloud Teams host and follows older-page links for the active conversation.
- Requests are capped at 200 messages per page, including saved settings from earlier versions. **Fetch full history** can still make up to 200 requests.
- The scrolling fallback collects messages as Teams replaces visible rows, deduplicates them, and restores the original scroll position.
- The troubleshooting guide explains how to verify the loaded version, tell an API export from a scrolling export, and interpret request errors.

## Install or update

Extract `TeamsChatExport-v6.7.5.zip` and select the extracted folder with **Load unpacked** in Chrome or Edge. Reload the extension after updating it, then refresh any open Teams tabs.
